summary: Model estimate (best-knowledge delta): Nigeria's largest LGBTQ+ scene and the most anonymity, but still an SSMPA-arrest jurisdiction — the State Police Command ran an intensified manhunt for two men (aged 43 and 54) accused of a same-sex relationship, caught at a residence on 30 June 2025. Scored relative to the national score (0.08) for Nigeria.

sources.summary: BBC News (9 Aug 2024): Nigerian transgender TikToker 'Abuja Area Mama', 33, found beaten dead on the Katampe-Mabushi expressway in Abuja; police opened a 'thorough and discreet' investigation; national context - same-sex conduct criminalised, mass arrests of LGBTQ+ Nigerians common, especially in northern states.
NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (returned only site navigation); the underlying Issue 25 feature covers LGBTQ rights in Nigeria and the Abuja Area Mama killing, per its URL slug.

Sahara Reporters (19 Aug 2026): the UK FCDO travel advisory warns LGBT+ travellers to Nigeria of arrest, violence, blackmail and intimidation - same-sex conduct carries up to 14 years' imprisonment federally; some northern states operate Sharia law where it can carry the death penalty; the Same Sex Marriage Prohibition Act also criminalises participants and guests at same-sex weddings.
